status: PROPOSAL (owned by L9; apply with tools/coverage after review). Nothing here has been applied.

param_extensions.why: Owner decision (MASTER-PLAN): AddToFaction/SetFactionRank on the player is SHARED. rules.py has no kind that says so: ShareKarmaRep only documents karma/reputation. Extending its params (instead of adding a 17th kind) keeps the runtime vocabulary at 16 kinds. Used for OmertaFaction (VMS21 stage 10 via Cachino, 31 AddToFaction occurrences in VMS21a).

functions found in the NCR scripts that rules.py COND_REDUCTION does not name. GetItemCount is safe as any-party-member only because quest items are duplicated to every player (QuestItemDup); GetButtonPressed returns the LOCAL message-box choice, so the initiator's answer must be forwarded to the host.

RulesEngine::onStageRequested defers EVERY stage request of a quest that carries Barrier/PartyTether (rules are per quest, not per stage). On VMQ05 that would hold stages 10-70 (set from dialogue and from VMS29 on the Strip) until all players 'pass'; the point-of-no-return is stage 100 only. Absent = all stages (backward compatible).

same reason: the curated vHDBattleController tether (HooverDamIntODeck, HooverDamIntPowerPlant, gather auto-warp) is checked on every stage request, including stage 20 (Legate yields, in the Legate camp) and stage 30 (Oliver's post-battle greeting), where the party is not in those interiors. Locations UNVERIFIED in game.

RulesEngine::desiredTravelLock locks fast travel only while a barrier is pending or a SetPlayerControls lock is active (a scene). vHDBattleController locks it for the whole battle (EnableFastTravel 0 0 1 every frame while iBattleState > 0), i.e. state-bound. Proposed semantics: locked from the first request of from_stage until until_stage completes. Also needs an applier for SetFastTravelLock (none in plugin/ today).

ops.why: Stage 30 (game over) and the Legate-camp end trigger lock the player; every party member must be locked and released by the same host effect. The curated entry only has PartyTether + PartyAwareCond, although main-ncr.md lists both CTRL lines.

The quest script calls EnableFastTravel 0 0 1 EVERY frame while iBattleState > 0 and stage 10 once; the policy text says 'fast travel is disabled party-wide' but no FastTravelLock rule exists, and quest scripts never run on guests (L5 round 4 gate). State-bound lock: see param_extensions (the shipped FastTravelLock is scene-bound).

THE NCR ENDING HAS NO SLIDESHOW RULE. tools/coverage/rules.py ENDING_SLIDESHOW lists VHDHouseBattle, VHDIndependentBattle, VHDLegionBattle, NVDLC02MQ06 but the NCR ending is vHDBattleController stage 30 -> StartQuest VEnding (there is no VHDNCRBattle quest).

Stage 30 is requested from the post-battle Oliver greeting (INFO 1483F0 begin: DisablePlayerControls + SetStage vHDBattleController 30) by whoever talks to him; the ending is irreversible and must wait for every present player. Barrier is the existing 'all players pass' kind, scoped to stage 30 (new `stages` param).
Arcade (VFSArcadeGannon GetPlayerTeammate), Boone/Cass/Veronica/Lily/Raul/Rex/ED-E are moved or disabled around the battle and the ending; owner = recruiter (open decision default).
dep obj VFSArcadeGannon:45 reads GetPlayerTeammate

The quest script itself branches on HooverDamIntODeck, HooverDamIntCheckpoint and HooverDamIntPowerPlant (lines 94-101); the curated tether only names two of the three interiors and not the exterior cell. Scoped to stage 10 (battle start) so the Legate and ending stages are not gated on the wrong interiors.

Moore's 'are you ready?' message box is the NCR point of no return: GetButtonPressed==1 sets VMQ05 stage 100, teleports and starts the battle. GetButtonPressed returns the LOCAL player's button, so a single player's click would commit everybody. Barrier scoped to stage 100 (new `stages` param): otherwise every VMQ05 stage request would wait for ScenePass intents. A client-side 'ready?' prompt that raises the ScenePass intent does not exist yet (open item).

Player.MoveTo vHDOliverTeleportMarker + MoveTo vHDOliverTPCompanionMarker for each hired companion. rules.json attaches this PartyWarp to VMQNCRFail (derived from the same Moore script), not to VMQ05 where the stage that triggers it lives. owner_questions.text: Irreversible solo actions on the NCR line: if one party member kills Moore/Crocker or attacks Kimball's guards, VMQNCRFail / VMQ03a fail the line for EVERYONE (shared story). Accept (one Courier) or warn the party first?
owner_questions.default: accept, but ForcedDialogue-style warning to all before the first hostile act is out of scope here
